exposure: aspirin combined with cytoreductive drugs or systemic anticoagulants
cohort: The study included 200 pregnancies from 100 women with essential thrombocythemia (ET) accessed from Mayo Clinic databases (1990-2023).
finding: Aspirin therapy significantly reduced the risk of first-trimester loss in women with essential thrombocythemia, independent of driver mutation status (JAK2/CALR) or other risk factors like prior fetal loss or diabetes mellitus.
